fields.requirement: Automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system
fields.receipt_binding: Every governed action emits a receipt at decision time, not after.

fields.requirement: Traceability of functioning: input data / data sources referenced
fields.receipt_binding: Evidence items are sha256-addressed; absence => INCOMPLETE.

fields.requirement: Identification of natural persons involved in verifying results (Art.12(3)(d) via Art.14 human oversight)
fields.receipt_binding: actor.is_service_account pinned false for human type; api_key cannot claim human.

fields.requirement: Recording of the period of each use (start/end)
fields.receipt_binding: ntp_synced const true; rfc3161_token for anti-backdating.
Ed25519 over DSSE PAE; hash chain via prev_chain_hash; offline verification.

fields.requirement: Logs retained per retention policy, min 6 months
fields.receipt_binding: PENDING_SYNC is a visible state during sink outage; local durability ACKed only after flock+fsync.

fields.requirement: Logs accessible to authorities / auditors on request
fields.receipt_binding: An external auditor verifies the bundle without entering the platform (offline verifier).

fields.requirement: Record of the AI system version / revision in use
fields.receipt_binding: Reviewed revision != executed revision unless attested; stage=RUNNING is not evidence.

known_gaps.item: rfc3161_token issuance requires a TSA integration; demo uses local ntp_synced attestation only.
Retention is a policy floor here; the retention tier (WORM storage) is a Control-plane feature.
